name: webscope
description: Test a web app with few tokens: read-only SQL, screen tests in Chrome, sent-vs-saved checks and code maps.

db_url.title: Database URL
db_url.description: mysql://user:pass@host:3306/name or sqlite:///path. Enables query, check and code fields. Leave empty to skip.

app_url.title: App URL
app_url.description: Exact origin of the tab to test, e.g. http://localhost:5173 (comma-separated for several). Enables page.

backend.title: Backend folder
backend.description: Folder with the project's PHP (Laravel). Enables code.

front.title: Front folder
front.description: Folder of the Vue front. Enables code map, map_back and contract.

legacy.title: Legacy folder
legacy.description: Folder of the legacy PHP, for code legacy.
